u_B = K_B * k_off_B * b_concentration
D = (u_A + k_off_A) * (u_B + k_off_B) - u_A * u_B
theta_A_equilibrium = u_A * k_off_B / D
theta_B_equilibrium = u_B * k_off_A / D
T = u_A + k_off_A + u_B + k_off_B

lambda_plus = (-T + delta) / 2
lambda_minus = (-T - delta) / 2

C_plus = (theta_B_equilibrium + (k_off_A - lambda_minus) * C_sum) / (2 * delta)
C_minus = C_sum - C_plus
amplitude_A_plus = u_A * C_plus
amplitude_A_minus = u_A * C_minus
amplitude_B_plus = (k_off_A - lambda_plus) * C_plus
amplitude_B_minus = (k_off_A - lambda_minus) * C_minus
response = k_cat * laplace_rate * (theta_A_equilibrium * theta_B_equilibrium / laplace_rate + theta_A_equilibrium * (amplitude_B_plus / (laplace_rate - lambda_plus) + amplitude_B_minus / (laplace_rate - lambda_minus)) + theta_B_equilibrium * (amplitude_A_plus / (laplace_rate - lambda_plus) + amplitude_A_minus / (laplace_rate - lambda_minus)) + (amplitude_A_plus * amplitude_B_plus / (laplace_rate - lambda_plus - lambda_plus) + amplitude_A_plus * amplitude_B_minus / (laplace_rate - lambda_plus - lambda_minus) + amplitude_A_minus * amplitude_B_plus / (laplace_rate - lambda_minus - lambda_plus) + amplitude_A_minus * amplitude_B_minus / (laplace_rate - lambda_minus - lambda_minus)))
